sentences.text: Third place stung less once he saw the winner's manten-stone ridge line up perfectly with its own reflection. One judge crouched at eye level with the aquarium for a full minute, saying nothing, pencil hovering. Records indicate the corydoras deposited eggs on the glass within six hours of the cool-water change. Eggs stuck to the heater cord again, which means scraping and praying half survive the move. Her ledger shows which pairings threw long fins and which threw nothing worth keeping. Wrigglers clung to the slate for two days before lifting off in one silver cloud. Would the guppy line hold its blue if I stopped pulling the fan-tailed males? He logs GH and KH in a spiral notebook, one column per shelf, dated in pencil. Fifteen points ride on hardscape composition alone, which explains why everyone hoards dragon stone like treasure. I mark each spawning jar's lid with tape: date, pair number, hardness at laying. At 6.4 pH the rams finally spawned, after months of stubborn refusal at 7.2. Newcomers learn the hard way that a focal point placed dead center costs points on every judge's sheet. Photography day means blackout curtains, a rented strobe, and forty minutes of coaxing the rummynose tetras into the golden-ratio zone. Hardness crept up to 240 ppm overnight — someone check whether the crushed coral bag split. Every runt gets fed to the bichir; sentiment doesn't pay for fish food. After the awards, competitors swapped trimming techniques over cold noodles, sketching hardscape ideas on the backs of their scoring sheets. Conditioning took two weeks of blackworms before the female finally plumped up enough to set. A dutch-style entry from Osaka stacked red ludwigia against limnophila in terraces so precise they looked machine-cut. His bucephalandra had melted two weeks before judging; he entered anyway. Water changes happen Sundays: twenty percent for growouts, ten for anything still at wriggler stage. What is the meaning of the word tank?
